```SNOBOL4
 DEFINE('WANG(ANTECEDENT,CONSEQUENT)PHI,PSI')
 UNOP = 'NOT'
 BINOP  = ('AND' | 'IMP' | 'OR' | 'EQU')
 UNOP.FORMULA = ' ' (UNOP . OP) '(' (BAL . PHI) ')'
 BINOP.FORMULA = ' ' (BINOP . OP) '(' (BAL . PHI) ','
+                    (BAL . PSI) ')'
 FORMULA = UNOP.FORMULA | BINOP.FORMULA
 ATOM = (NOTANY(' ') (BREAK(' ') | REM)) . A
                                               :(WANG.END)
WANG
       ANTECEDENT FORMULA = NULL
+             :F(WANG1)S( $('WANG.A.' OP) )
WANG.A.NOT
       WANG(ANTECEDENT, CONSEQUENT ' ' PHI)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.A.AND
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PHI ' ' PSI, CONSEQUENT)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.A.OR
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PHI, CONSEQUENT)     :F(FRETURN)
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PSI, CONSEQUENT)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.A.IMP
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PSI, CONSEQUENT)     :F(FRETURN)
       WANG(ANTECEDENT, CONSEQUENT ' ' PHI)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.A.EQU
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PHI ' ' PSI, CONSEQUENT)
+        :F(FRETURN)
       WANG(ANTECEDENT, CONSEQUENT ' ' PHI ' ' PSI)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG1
       CONSEQUENT FORMULA =
+          :F(WANG2)S( $('WANG.C.' OP) )
WANG.C.NOT
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PHI, CONSEQUENT)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.C.AND
       WANG(ANTECEDENT, CONSEQUENT ' ' PHI)       :F(FRETURN)
       WANG(ANTECEDENT, CONSEQUENT ' ' PSI)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.C.OR
       WANG(ANTECEDENT, CONSEQUENT ' ' PHI ' ' PSI)
+          :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.C.IMP
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PHI, CONSEQUENT ' ' PSI)
+         :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG.C.EQU
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PHI, CONSEQUENT ' ' PSI)
+        :F(FRETURN)
       WANG(ANTECEDENT ' ' PSI, CONSEQUENT ' ' PHI)
+        :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WANG2
       ANTECEDENT ATOM =                          :F(FRETURN)
       CONSEQUENT A                               :S(RETURN)F(WANG2)
WANG.END
 &ANCHOR = 0
 &FULLSCAN = 1
 &TRIM = 1
       VALID = WANG(NULL, ' IMP(NOT(OR(P,Q)),NOT(P))')  'VALID'
+                                                         :S(END)
       VALID = 'INVALID'
END
```

## t_aisnobol__ending_ed_forms

```SNOBOL4
 &FULLSCAN = 1
 &TRIM = 1
 DEFINE('WORDEND(WORD)L,VOWEL,DOUBLE,LIQUID,NOEND')
 DEFINE('MATCH(L,PAT)')
 DEFINE('CUT(N)')
 DEFINE('ADDON(X)')
 DEFINE('TRY()')
            :(WORDEND.END)
WORDEND
        WRD = WORD
        DOUBLE = (LEN(1) $ L) *L RPOS(0)
        LIQUID = ANY("LRSVZ")
        NOEND = ANY("CGSVZ")
        VOWEL = ANY("AEIOUY")
        WRD
+       ("N'T" | "'S" | "S'" | "S" | "LY" |
+        "ING" | "ED" | "EN" | "ER" | "EST")
+        $ WEND RPOS(0) =                          :F(WTRY)
        WEND POS(0) ("S" | "'S" | "S'" | "N'T") RPOS(0)
+                                                 :F(WORDEND.1)
        MATCH(1,"E")                              :F(WTRY)
        MATCH(2,"I") CUT(2) ADDON("Y")            :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(2,"TH")                             :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(2,ANY("HX")) CUT(1)                 :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(2,ANY("SZ") ANY("SZ")) CUT(1)       :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(2,ANY("SZ"))                        :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(2,"V")                              :F(WTRY)
        ~TRY() CUT(2) ADDON("FE")                 :S(WTRY)F(RETURN)
WORDEND.1
        IDENT(WEND,"LY")                          :F(WORDEND.2)
        MATCH(1,"I") CUT(1) ADDON("Y")            :S(WTRY)
        ~TRY() ADDON("LE")                        :S(WTRY)F(RETURN)
WORDEND.2
        MATCH(1,VOWEL)                            :F(WORDEND.3)
        MATCH(1,"I") CUT(1) ADDON("Y")            :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(1,"Y")                              :S(WTRY)
        ~MATCH(1,"E") ADDON("E")                  :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(2,"E")                              :S(WTRY)
        ~TRY() ADDON("E")                         :S(WTRY)F(RETURN)
WORDEND.3
        MATCH(1,"H")                              :F(WORDEND.4)
        MATCH(2,"T")                              :F(WTRY)
        ~TRY() ADDON("E")                         :S(WTRY)F(RETURN)
WORDEND.4
        WRD DOUBLE                                :F(WORDEND.5)
        ~MATCH(1,LIQUID) CUT(1)                   :S(WTRY)
        ~TRY() CUT(1)                             :S(WTRY)F(RETURN)
WORDEND.5
        MATCH(2,VOWEL)                            :S(WORDEND.6)
        MATCH(1,"RL")                             :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(1,LIQUID | NOEND) ADDON("E")        :(WTRY)
WORDEND.6
        ~MATCH(3,VOWEL) ADDON("E")                :S(WTRY)
        MATCH(1,NOEND) ADDON("E")                 :(WTRY)
WTRY    TRY()                                     :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
MATCH
        WRD PAT RPOS(L - 1)                       :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
CUT
        WRD RPOS(N) REM =                         :(RETURN)
ADDON
        WRD = WRD X                               :(RETURN)
TRY
        DIFFER(DICTIONARY<WRD>)                   :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
WORDEND.END
 DICTIONARY = TABLE(101)
 WORDS =
+     'BASH,BATHE,LEAN,LEAVE,DENT,DANCE,DOG,KISS,CURVE,'
+     'CURL,ROT,ROLL,PLAY,PLY,REAL,PALE,KNIFE,PRETTY,'
+     'NOBLE,PATROL,'
DICT.LOOP
       WORDS BREAK(',') . W LEN(1) =              :F(DICT.DONE)
       DICTIONARY<W> = 1                          :(DICT.LOOP)
DICT.DONE
       WORDEND('DENTED')   :F(END)
       R_DENTED = WRD
       WORDEND('CURVED')   :F(END)
       R_CURVED = WRD
       WORDEND('PALED')    :F(END)
       R_PALED = WRD
END
```

```SNOBOL4
CUT

ADDON

TRY

WORDEND.END
```

## t_aisnobol__shafto_hsort_two_elements

```SNOBOL4
 DEFINE('HSORT(A,I,N,P)J,K,C')
 DEFINE('HSORT.KO(V1,V2)')
 DEFINE('HSORT.OK(V1,V2)')
 DEFINE('HSORT.SWAP(I1,I2)T')              :(HSORT.END)
HSORT
      GT(N - I,  1)                        :S(HSORT1)
      GE(I, N)                             :S(RETURN)
      (HSORT.KO(A<I>,A<N>)   HSORT.SWAP(I,N))
         :(RETURN)
HSORT1
      C = A<(I + N) / 2>
      J = I - 1
      K = N + 1
HSORT2   J = J + 1
      HSORT.OK(C,A<J>)                     :F(HSORT2)
HSORT3   K = K - 1
      HSORT.OK(A<K>,C)                     :F(HSORT3)
      (LT(J,K)    HSORT.SWAP(J,K))         :S(HSORT2)
      HSORT(A, I, K, P)
      HSORT(A, K + 1, N, P)                :(RETURN)
HSORT.SWAP  T = A<I1> ; A<I1> = A<I2> ; A<I2> = T     :(RETURN)
HSORT.OK      APPLY(P,V1,V2)               :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
HSORT.KO      APPLY(P,V1,V2)               :S(FRETURN)F(RETURN)
HSORT.END
      A = ARRAY(2)
      A<1> = 'Z'
      A<2> = 'A'
      HSORT(A, 1, 2, .LLE)
END
```

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "DECOMB.INC"
* DECOMP.inc - DECOMP(S) returns the decimal number equivalent
*	       of the argument S regarded as a representation
*	       in the combinatorial number system.
*
*-FILE-ENTER "comb.inc"
* COMB.inc - COMB(N,M) returns the number of combinations
*	     of N things, taken M at a time.
*
	DEFINE('COMB(N,M)')			:(COMB_END)
COMB	COMB  =  EQ(M,0)  1			:S(RETURN)
	COMB  =  COMB(N - 1,M - 1) * N / M	:(RETURN)
COMB_END
*-FILE-LEAVE
	DEFINE('DECOMB(S)T')
	COMB_ALPHA  =  '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP'
						:(DECOMB_END)
DECOMB	S  LEN(1) . T  =			:F(RETURN)
	COMB_ALPHA  @K  T			:F(FRETURN)
	DECOMB = DECOMB + COMB(K,SIZE(S) + 1)	:(DECOMB)
DECOMB_END
*-FILE-LEAVE
        D0 = DECOMB('0')
        D1 = DECOMB('1')
        DA = DECOMB('A')
END
```

## t_gimpel__gimpel_base10_from_binary

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "BASE10.INC"
* BASE10 - BASE10(N,B) will convert the string N assumed
*	   to be a numeral expressed in base B arithmetic
*	   to decimal (base 10).
*
*	   Digits beyond 0-9 are from the set A-Z.
*
	DEFINE('BASE10(N,B)T')
	BASEB_ALPHA  =  '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
						:(BASE10_END)
BASE10	N   LEN(1) . T  =			:F(RETURN)
	BASEB_ALPHA    BREAK(*T)  @T		:F(ERROR)
	BASE10  =  (BASE10 * B) + T		:(BASE10)
BASE10_END
*-FILE-LEAVE

        D2 = BASE10('FF',16)
END
```

## t_gimpel__gimpel_baseb_base2

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "BASEB.INC"
*  BASEB(N,B) will convert the integer N to its base B representation.
*
*  B may be any positive integer <=36.
*
	DEFINE('BASEB(N,B)R,C')
	BASEB_ALPHA  =  '0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
						:(BASEB_END)
BASEB	EQ(N,0)					:S(RETURN)
	R  =  REMDR(N,B)
	BASEB_ALPHA  TAB(*R)   LEN(1) . C	:F(ERROR)
	BASEB  =  C BASEB
	N  =  N / B				:(BASEB)
BASEB_END
*-FILE-LEAVE
        B2  = BASEB(10,2)
        B16 = BASEB(255,16)
END
```

## t_gimpel__gimpel_floor_function

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "FLOOR.INC"
* FLOORCEIL.inc
*	FLOOR(X) will return the largest integer not greater than X.
*	CEIL(X) will return the smallest integer not less than X.
*
*-FILE-ENTER "dexp.inc"
* DEXP.inc - DEXP(PROTO) defines functions in terms of a
*	     simple, one-line expression, such as
*		DEXP('AVE(X,Y) = (X + Y) / 2.0')
*
	DEFINE('DEXP(PROTO)NAME,ARGS')		:(DEXP_END)
DEXP	PROTO   POS(0)  SPAN(' ')  =
	PROTO   BREAK('(') . NAME  BAL . ARGS  =  NAME
	CODE(NAME  ' '  PROTO  '		:S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)')
	DEFINE(NAME  ARGS)			:(RETURN)
DEXP_END
```

```SNOBOL4
REPL_2	REPL  =  REPL  S1			:(RETURN)
REPL_END
```

```SNOBOL4

* CRACK.inc - CRACK(S,B) will convert from string to array

-FILE-ENTER "count.inc"
* COUNT.inc - COUNT(S1,S2) counts the number of occurrences
*	      of string S2 in string S1.
*
-FILE-ENTER "breakx.inc"
* BREAKX.inc - BREAKX(S) will return a pattern that will
*	       extend itself to include characters from S
*	       if required by a rematch attempt.
*	       
*  Built-in function in SNOBOL4+ and SPITBOL.
*
*	DEFINE('BREAKX(S)')			:(BREAKX_END)
*BREAKX	BREAKX  =  BREAK(S)  ARBNO(LEN(1) BREAK(S))
*						:(RETURN)
*BREAKX_END
-FILE-LEAVE
	DEFINE('COUNT(S1,S2)FIRST,REST,P')
						:(COUNT_END)
COUNT	S2    LEN(1) . FIRST   REM . REST	:F(RETURN)
	P  =  POS(0)  BREAKX(FIRST)  S2
COUNT_1	S1    P  =  REST			:F(RETURN)
	COUNT  =  COUNT + 1			:(COUNT_1)
COUNT_END
-FILE-LEAVE
	DEFINE('CRACK(S,B)I,PAT')		:(CRACK_END)
CRACK	IDENT(B,NULL)				:S(CRACK_1)
	S   RTAB(1) B ABORT | REM . S  =  S B
	CRACK  =  ARRAY(COUNT(S,B))
	PAT  =  BREAK(B) . *CRACK<I>  LEN(1)
CRACK_2	I  =  I + 1
	S   PAT  =				:S(CRACK_2)F(RETURN)
CRACK_1	CRACK  =  ARRAY(SIZE(S))
	PAT  =  LEN(1) . *CRACK<I>		:(CRACK_2)
CRACK_END
-FILE-LEAVE
        A = CRACK('A,B,C',',')
        E1 = A<1>
        E2 = A<2>
        E3 = A<3>
     END
```

## t_gimpel__gimpel_sqrt_function

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "SQRT.INC"
-MODULE SQRT
*
*  Note:  SNOBOL4+ allows exponentiation to a real power.
*  Therefore, we have replaced the following code with
*  a much more efficient form, and bypass the traditional
*  function definition.
*
	DEFINE('SQRT(Y)T,ERR,SLOPE')		:(SQRT_END)
SQRT
* Remove the following statement for non-SNOBOL4+ systems:
	SQRT = Y ** 0.5				:(RETURN)

	LT(Y,0)					:S(FRETURN)
	EQ(Y,0)					:S(RETURN)
	SQRT = LT(Y,0.05)  1. / SQRT(1. / Y)	:S(RETURN)
	SQRT = GT(Y,4096) SQRT(Y / 4096.) * 64.	:S(RETURN)
	SQRT = GT(Y,16)   SQRT(Y / 16.) * 4.	:S(RETURN)
	SQRT = (Y + 1.) / 2.
	T    = SQRT
SQRT_1	ERR   =  SQRT * SQRT - Y
	SLOPE =  2. * SQRT
	SQRT  =  SQRT - (ERR / SLOPE)
	T     =  LT(SQRT,T)  SQRT		:S(SQRT_1)F(RETURN)
SQRT_END
*-FILE-LEAVE
        RSQRT4 = SQRT(4.0)
        RSQRT9 = SQRT(9.0)
        RSQRT2 = SQRT(2.0)
END
```

## t_gimpel__gimpel_rotater_right

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "ROTATER.INC"
* ROTATER.inc - ROTATER(S,N) will rotate the string S right by N
*		characters.  If N is negative, rotation is to the
*		left.
*
	DEFINE('ROTATER(S,N)S1')		:(ROTATER_END)
ROTATER	IDENT(S)				:S(RETURN)
	N  =  REMDR(N, SIZE(S))
	N  =  LT(N,0)  SIZE(S) - N
	S    RTAB(N) . S  REM . S1  =  S1  S
	ROTATER  =  S				:(RETURN)
ROTATER_END
*-FILE-LEAVE
        R1 = ROTATER('ABCDE',2)
        R2 = ROTATER('ABCDE',0)
```

```SNOBOL4
* PERMUTATE.inc - PERMUTATION(S,I) will return the Ith permutation of

	DEFINE('PERMUTATION(S,I)RADIX,T,S1,N')
						:(PERMUTATION_END)
PERMUTATION
	PERMUTATION  =  EQ(I,0)  PERMUTATION S	:S(RETURN)

	RADIX  =  RADIX + 1

PERMUTATION_END
```

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "AGT.INC"
* AGT - Alphabetic comparison with upper and lower case letters
*       treated as equal.

*	&COMPARE = 1, and use the regular LGT operator.

	UPPERS_ = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
	LOWERS_ = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'
	AGT_TT  =  REPLACE(&ALPHABET, UPPERS_, LOWERS_)
						:(AGT_END)
AGT	LGT( REPLACE(S1, &ALPHABET, AGT_TT),
+	REPLACE(S2, &ALPHABET, AGT_TT))		:S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
AGT_END

DONE2
END
```

## t_gimpel__gimpel_spell_numbers

```SNOBOL4
*-FILE-ENTER "SPELL.INC"
* SPELL.inc - SPELL(N) will return an English phrase designating
*	      the integer N.  Thus SPELL(13) will return "THIRTEEN".
*
	DEFINE('SPELL(N)M')			:(SPELL_END)
SPELL	GE(N,1000)				:S(SPELL_1000)
	GE(N,100)				:S(SPELL_100)
	GE(N,20)				:S(SPELL_20)
	GE(N,13)				:S(SPELL_13)
	('1ONE,2TWO,3THREE,4FOUR,5FIVE,6SIX,7SEVEN,8EIGHT,9NINE,'
+	'10TEN,11ELEVEN,12TWELVE,')  N  ARB . SPELL  ','  :(RETURN)
SPELL_13	N  1  LEN(1) . M
	SPELL  =  SPELL(M 0)
	SPELL   'TY'  =  'TEEN'
	SPELL   'FOR'  =  'FOUR'		:(RETURN)
SPELL_20	N  LEN(1) . M  =
	'2TWEN,3THIR,4FOR,5FIF,6SIX,7SEVEN,8EIGH,9NINE,'
+	M   BREAK(',') . SPELL
	SPELL  =  SPELL  'TY'
	SPELL = NE(N,0) SPELL '-' SPELL(N)	:(RETURN)
SPELL_100	N  LEN(1) . M  =
	SPELL  =  SPELL(M)  ' HUNDRED'
	SPELL = NE(N,0) SPELL ' AND ' SPELL(+N)	:(RETURN)
SPELL_1000
	N   RTAB(3) . M  =
	SPELL  =  SPELL(M)
	SPELL   'THOUSAND'  =  'MILLION'
	SPELL  =  SPELL  ' THOUSAND'
	SPELL  =  NE(N,0)  SPELL ' AND ' SPELL(+N)  :(RETURN)
SPELL_END
*-FILE-LEAVE
        S1  = SPELL(1)
        S13 = SPELL(13)
        S42 = SPELL(42)
END
```

## t_spitbol__t2_any_notany

```SNOBOL4
         STARS = '  ERROR DETECTED          ***'
         TEST = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
         TEST ANY('MXZ') $ VARA       :S(S74) ; TEST = STARS

S75      TEST ANY(',.')               :F(S76) ; TEST = STARS
S76      TEST NOTANY('ABCDEFGHJKLMPQRSTUWXYZ') $ VARA :S(S77) ; TEST = STARS
S77      IDENT(VARA,'I')              :S(S78) ; TEST = STARS
S78      TEST NOTANY(TEST)            :F(S79) ; TEST = STARS
S79
END
```

## t_worm_algorithms__t_sieve_primes_to_20

```SNOBOL4
        N = 20
        A = ARRAY(20)
        I = 2
INIT    A<I> = 1
        I = I + 1
        LE(I,N) :S(INIT)
        I = 2
OUTER   EQ(A<I>,0) :S(SKIP_I)
        J = I * 2
INNER   GT(J,N) :S(SKIP_I)
        A<J> = 0
        J = J + I
        :(INNER)
SKIP_I  I = I + 1
        LE(I,N) :S(OUTER)
        CNT = 0
        I = 2
COUNT   EQ(A<I>,1) :F(CNT_SKIP)
        CNT = CNT + 1
CNT_SKIP I = I + 1
        LE(I,N) :S(COUNT)
end
```

## t_worm_algorithms__t_binary_search_not_found

```SNOBOL4
        A = ARRAY(5)
        A<1> = 1
        A<2> = 3
        A<3> = 5
        A<4> = 7
        A<5> = 9
        TARGET = 4
        LO = 1
        HI = 5
        POS = -1
BLOOP   GT(LO,HI) :S(BDONE)
        MID = (LO + HI) / 2
        EQ(A<MID>,TARGET) :S(BFOUND)
        LT(A<MID>,TARGET) :S(BHIGH)
        HI = MID - 1
        :(BLOOP)
BHIGH   LO = MID + 1
        :(BLOOP)
BFOUND  POS = MID
BDONE   end
```

```SNOBOL4
        N = 6

        STEPS = STEPS + 1

        N = 3 * N + 1
        :(LOOP)
EVEN    N = N / 2
        :(LOOP)
```

## t_worm_algorithms__t_bubble_sort_5

```SNOBOL4
        GT(K,N) :S(NEXT_I)
        GT(A<J>,A<K>) :F(SKIP)
        T = A<J>
        A<J> = A<K>
        A<K> = T
SKIP    J = J + 1
        LT(J,N) :S(INNER)
NEXT_I  I = I + 1

end
```

## t_worm_algorithms__t_binary_search_found

```SNOBOL4
        A = ARRAY(5)
        A<1> = 1
        A<2> = 3
        A<3> = 5
        A<4> = 7
        A<5> = 9
        TARGET = 7
        LO = 1
        HI = 5
        POS = -1
BLOOP   GT(LO,HI) :S(BDONE)
        MID = (LO + HI) / 2
        EQ(A<MID>,TARGET) :S(BFOUND)
        LT(A<MID>,TARGET) :S(BHIGH)
        HI = MID - 1
        :(BLOOP)
BHIGH   LO = MID + 1
        :(BLOOP)
BFOUND  POS = MID
BDONE   end
```

## t_worm_patterns__t_word_count_pattern

```SNOBOL4
        S = 'one two three '
        N = 0
        I = 1
LOOP    SUBSTR(S,I,SIZE(S) - I + 1) BREAK(' ') . W LEN(1)  :F(DONE)
        N = N + 1
        I = I + SIZE(W) + 1
        LE(I,SIZE(S)) :S(LOOP)
DONE    end
```

## core_test__continue-resumes-at-the-innermost-failure-point

```SNOBOL4
        &ERRLIMIT = 30
        ZERO = 0
        DEFINE('H()')                       :(HE)
H       H = .E
        DIFFER(H)                           :S(NRETURN)F(FRETURN)
HE      DEFINE('G()')                       :(GE)
G       G = ~$H() 'g'                       :S(RETURN)F(FRETURN)
GE      SETEXIT('ERR')
        X = $H()                            :S(S1)F(F1)
S1      OUTPUT = 'succ1 [' X ']'            :(N2)
F1      OUTPUT = 'fail1'                    :(N2)
ERR     OUTPUT = 'ERROR ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &FNCLEVEL
        SETEXIT('ERR')                      :(CONTINUE)
N2      Y = ~$H()                           :S(S2)F(F2)
S2      OUTPUT = 'succ2 [' Y ']'            :(N3)
F2      OUTPUT = 'fail2'
N3      Y = ($H(), 'b')                     :S(S3)F(F3)
S3      OUTPUT = 'succ3 [' Y ']'            :(N4)
F3      OUTPUT = 'fail3'
N4      SETEXIT('VIA')
        Y = ~$H()                           :S(S4)F(F4)
S4      OUTPUT = 'succ4 [' Y ']'            :(N5)
F4      OUTPUT = 'fail4'                    :(N5)
VIA     OUTPUT = 'VIA ' &ERRTYPE            :(VIA2)
VIA2    OUTPUT = 'VIA2'
        SETEXIT('ERR')                      :(CONTINUE)
N5      SETEXIT('ERR')
        Y = EVAL('~$H()')                   :S(S5)F(F5)
S5      OUTPUT = 'succ5 [' Y ']'            :(N6)
F5      OUTPUT = 'fail5'
N6      Y = (EVAL('$H()'), 'e')             :S(S6)F(F6)
S6      OUTPUT = 'succ6 [' Y ']'            :(N7)
F6      OUTPUT = 'fail6'
N7      Y = G()                             :S(S7)F(F7)
S7      OUTPUT = 'succ7 [' Y ']'            :(N8)
F7      OUTPUT = 'fail7'
N8      SETEXIT('AWAY')
        Y = ~$H()                           :S(S8)F(F8)
S8      OUTPUT = 'succ8 [' Y ']'            :(N9)
F8      OUTPUT = 'fail8'                    :(N9)
AWAY    OUTPUT = 'AWAY ' &ERRTYPE
N9      OUTPUT = 'at N9'
        SETEXIT('USED')
        Y = ~$H()                           :S(S10)F(F10)
S10     OUTPUT = 'succ10 [' Y ']'           :(N11)
F10     OUTPUT = 'fail10'                   :(N11)
USED    OUTPUT = 'USED ' &ERRTYPE
        Z = 1 / ZERO
        OUTPUT = 'after untrapped ' &ERRTYPE
        SETEXIT('E37')                      :(CONTINUE)
E37     OUTPUT = 'E37 ' &ERRTYPE
N11     OUTPUT = 'end ' &ERRLIMIT
END
```

## core_test__eval-and-convert-take-one-expression-to-its-end

```SNOBOL4
        R = EVAL('4 :(L)') 'succ'                       :S(A)
        R = 'fail ' &ERRTYPE
A       S = EVAL(' B = 4 :S(OK)') 'succ'                :S(B)
        S = 'fail ' &ERRTYPE
B       T = EVAL('4; 5') 'succ'                         :S(C)
        T = 'fail ' &ERRTYPE
C       U = EVAL('4 + ; ') 'succ'                       :S(D)
        U = 'fail ' &ERRTYPE
D       V = EVAL('(4 :(L))') 'succ'                     :S(E)
        V = 'fail ' &ERRTYPE
E       W = EVAL("'a:b;c'")
        OUTPUT = R '|' S '|' T '|' U '|' V '|' W
        &ERRLIMIT = 10
        X = EVAL('4 ;') 'succ'                          :S(F)
        X = 'error ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
F       Y = EVAL(':') 'succ'                            :S(G)
        Y = 'error ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
G       OUTPUT = X '|' Y
        SETEXIT(.H)
        Z = EVAL('X ;')
        OUTPUT = 'not here'                             :(END)
H       OUTPUT = 'handler ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
        V = CONVERT('4 +', 'EXPRESSION')                :S(END)
        OUTPUT = '1 ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
        V = CONVERT('4 :(L)', 'EXPRESSION')             :S(END)
        OUTPUT = '2 ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
        V = CONVERT('4 + ;', 'EXPRESSION')              :S(END)
        OUTPUT = '3 ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
        V = CONVERT('(4 :(L))', 'EXPRESSION')           :S(END)
        OUTPUT = '4 ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
        V = CONVERT('0:35', 'EXPRESSION')               :S(END)
        OUTPUT = '5 ' &ERRTYPE ' ' &ERRLIMIT
END
```

```stdout
fail 103|fail 103|fail 103|fail 221|fail 226|a:b;c
error 103 9|error 103 8
handler 103 7
1 221 6
2 221 6
3 221 6
4 226 5
5 226 5
```

```SNOBOL4
 I = I + 1
 LE(I,5)                               :S(IL)
END
```

```SNOBOL4
        &ERRLIMIT = 40
        T = TABLE()
        A = ARRAY(2)
        N = .&ERRTEXT
        M = .A[1]
        X = 'x'
        P = LEN(1)
        E = *X
        V = T 'x'                       :S(E1)
        OUTPUT = '1 ' &ERRTYPE
E1      V = 'x' A                       :S(E2)
        OUTPUT = '2 ' &ERRTYPE
E2      V = 'x' 'y' N                   :S(E3)
        OUTPUT = '3 ' &ERRTYPE
E3      V = M 'y'                       :S(E4)
        OUTPUT = '4 ' &ERRTYPE
E4      V = N P                         :S(E5)
        OUTPUT = '5 ' &ERRTYPE
E5      V = P T                         :S(E6)
        OUTPUT = '6 ' &ERRTYPE
E6      V = .X 'y'
        OUTPUT = '7 ' V ' ' DATATYPE(E 'y') ' ' DATATYPE(.X P)
        N ? 'x'                         :S(E8)
        OUTPUT = '8 ' &ERRTYPE
E8      T ? 'x'                         :S(E9)
        OUTPUT = '9 ' &ERRTYPE
E9      .X ? 'X'                        :F(E10)
        OUTPUT = '10 ok'
E10     OUTPUT = '11 ' (IDENT(N 'a') 'i', 'n') ' ' &ERRTYPE
        OUTPUT = '11b ' DATATYPE('' T) ' ' DATATYPE(T '') ' ' DATATYPE('' N '')
        OUTPUT = N
        OUTPUT = .X
        OUTPUT = M
        X = 'xv'
        OUTPUT = '12 [' EVAL(.X) ']'
        V = EVAL(TABLE())                :S(E13)
        OUTPUT = '13 ' &ERRTYPE
E13     V = EVAL(LEN(1))                 :S(E14)
        OUTPUT = '14 ' &ERRTYPE
E14     &ERRTYPE = 0
        V = EVAL(N)                      :S(E15)
        OUTPUT = '15 ' &ERRTYPE
E15     OUTPUT = '16 ' CONVERT(.X, 'STRING') ' ' (CONVERT(M, 'STRING'), 'nope') ' ' DATATYPE(CONVERT(.X, 'PATTERN')) ' ' (CONVERT(N, 'PATTERN'), 'nope')
END
```

## core_test__a-channel-may-be-a-string-or-a-name

```SNOBOL4
        &ERRLIMIT = 10
        INPUT(.X, 'chan', 'in.txt')                :S(A1)
        OUTPUT = 'input fails ' &ERRTYPE           :(A2)
A1      OUTPUT = '1 ' X ' ' X
A2      REWIND('chan')
        OUTPUT = '2 ' X
        INPUT(.Y, .LIB, 'in.txt')                  :S(B1)
        OUTPUT = 'name fails ' &ERRTYPE            :(B2)
B1      OUTPUT = '3 ' Y
B2      OUTPUT(.O, 'outc', 'out.txt')
        O = 'written'
        ENDFILE('outc')
        INPUT(.Z, 'zz', 'out.txt')
        OUTPUT = '4 ' Z
        REWIND(.LIB)
        OUTPUT = '5 ' Y
        INPUT(.W, '7', 'in.txt')
        REWIND(7)
        OUTPUT = '6 ' W
        BACKSPACE('chan')
        OUTPUT = '7 ' X
END
```

```file c.sno
        &ERRLIMIT = 10
        INPUT(.X, 'chan', 'in.txt')                :S(A1)
        OUTPUT = 'input fails ' &ERRTYPE           :(A2)
A1      OUTPUT = '1 ' X ' ' X
A2      REWIND('chan')
        OUTPUT = '2 ' X
        INPUT(.Y, .LIB, 'in.txt')                  :S(B1)
        OUTPUT = 'name fails ' &ERRTYPE            :(B2)
B1      OUTPUT = '3 ' Y
B2      OUTPUT(.O, 'outc', 'out.txt')
        O = 'written'
        ENDFILE('outc')
        INPUT(.Z, 'zz', 'out.txt')
        OUTPUT = '4 ' Z
        REWIND(.LIB)
        OUTPUT = '5 ' Y
        INPUT(.W, '7', 'in.txt')
        REWIND(7)
        OUTPUT = '6 ' W
        BACKSPACE('chan')
        OUTPUT = '7 ' X
END
```

```file in.txt
one
two
```

```stdout
3 one

6 one
7 one
written
```

```SNOBOL4
        X = -BIG - 2
```

```SNOBOL4

        CODE(S)                                 :F(B2)
```

```SNOBOL4
N2      V = EVAL("X Y ? 'b' = 'c'")             :F(B3)
        OUTPUT = 'eval ok ' V                   :(N3)
B3      OUTPUT = 'eval ' &ERRTYPE
N3      V = EVAL("X ? 'b' = 'c'")               :F(B4)

        OUTPUT = 'eval3 ok ' V                  :(N5)
```

## core_test__sort-and-rsort-are-stable-on-a-column-and-tables-keep-their-order

```SNOBOL4
        t = TABLE()
        t['pear'] = 3
        t['apple'] = 5
        t['fig'] = 3
        t['kiwi'] = 1
        t['date'] = 5
        t['cherry'] = 3
        arr = CONVERT(t,'ARRAY')
        i = 1
L0      OUTPUT = 'raw  ' arr<i,1> ' ' arr<i,2>   :F(R1)
        i = i + 1                                :(L0)
R1      b = RSORT(arr,2)
        i = 1
L1      OUTPUT = 'rs2  ' b<i,1> ' ' b<i,2>       :F(R2)
        i = i + 1                                :(L1)
R2      b = SORT(arr,2)
        i = 1
L2      OUTPUT = 's2   ' b<i,1> ' ' b<i,2>       :F(R3)
        i = i + 1                                :(L2)
R3      b = SORT(arr,1)
        i = 1
L3      OUTPUT = 's1   ' b<i,1> ' ' b<i,2>       :F(R4)
        i = i + 1                                :(L3)
R4      b = RSORT(arr)
        i = 1
L4      OUTPUT = 'rs   ' b<i,1> ' ' b<i,2>       :F(R5)
        i = i + 1                                :(L4)
R5      b = SORT(t)
        i = 1
L5      OUTPUT = 'st   ' b<i,1> ' ' b<i,2>       :F(R6)
        i = i + 1                                :(L5)
R6      OUTPUT = 'done'
END
```

```SNOBOL4
 T = TABLE(); T<'k'> = 'v'
 OUTPUT = IDENT(.T<'k'>,.T<'k'>) 'elem-same'
 OUTPUT = IDENT(.T<'k'>,.T<'j'>) 'elem-diff-yes'
END
```

```stdout
same
differ-yes
elem-same
```

## test_cooper__gimpel-bsort

```SNOBOL4
        DEFINE('BSORT(A,I,N)J,K,V')  :(BSORT_END)
BSORT   J  =  I
BSORT_1 J  =  J + 1  LT(J,N)         :F(RETURN)
        K  =  J
        V  =  A<J>
BSORT_2 K  =  K - 1  GT(K,I)         :F(BSORT_RO)
        A<K + 1>  =  LGT(A<K>,V)  A<K>  :S(BSORT_2)
        A<K + 1>  =  V               :(BSORT_1)
BSORT_RO A<I>  =  V                  :(BSORT_1)
BSORT_END
        ARR = ARRAY(5)
        ARR<1> = 'pear'
        ARR<2> = 'apple'
        ARR<3> = 'mango'
        ARR<4> = 'banana'
        ARR<5> = 'cherry'
        BSORT(ARR,1,5)
        R1 = ARR<1>
        R2 = ARR<2>
        R3 = ARR<3>
        R4 = ARR<4>
        R5 = ARR<5>
END
```

## test_csnobol4_suite__fence-061-pat-fence-fn-seal

```SNOBOL4
*  061 - FENCE(P) seals: backtrack cannot re-enter P's alternatives
*  Without fence: FENCE(LEN(1)|LEN(2)) RPOS(0) on 'AB' would succeed
*  via LEN(2). With fence: LEN(1) chosen, sealed, RPOS(0) fails -> match fails.
*  The match is anchored: unanchored, the scan would try the next start position and succeed there (sbl -bf).
        &ANCHOR = 1
        X = 'AB'
        X  FENCE(LEN(1) | LEN(2))  RPOS(0)                   :S(YES)F(NO)
YES     OUTPUT = 'should not reach'                            :(END)
NO      OUTPUT = 'sealed correctly'
END
```

```stdout
sealed correctly
```

```SNOBOL4
*  059 - FENCE(P) basic: P matches, overall match succeeds
        X = 'hello'

        OUTPUT = 'matched'                                     :(END)
NO      OUTPUT = 'failed'
END
```

```stdout
matched
```

```SNOBOL4
+          |   SPAN(digits)
```

## test_csnobol4_suite__fence-067-pat-fence-fn-vs-kw

```SNOBOL4
*  067 - FENCE(P) vs &FENCE: FENCE(P) fails gracefully, &FENCE aborts entire match
*  &FENCE: backtrack into it kills the whole statement (goes to F, not S)
        X = 'AX'
        X  LEN(1)  FENCE  LEN(2)                              :S(BAD)
*  FENCE(P): when P fails, statement takes F branch normally
        X  FENCE('Z')                                         :S(BAD)
        OUTPUT = 'both correct'                               :(END)
BAD     OUTPUT = 'wrong'
END
```

```stdout
both correct
```
